items.title: A large outbreak of acute gastroenteritis caused by rare group C rotavirus in schoolchildren in Yunnan, China: Clinical, epidemiological, and genomic characterization
items.origin: Virology · Cao Y, Che R, Ma M, Kong L, Jiang S, Li D, Sun X, Gu W.
items.excerpt: We investigated the etiology, molecular epidemiology, and glycan-binding architecture of an acute gastroenteritis (AGE) outbreak among students at a primary school in Yunnan Province, China. After an institutional outbreak was declared in March 2025, we conducted epidemiological investigations and collected 25 specimens.
